slides.body: A new Guardian investigation finds that reports of wide-scale AI job replacement are overblown. Large corporations are using AI to trim headcount — but small businesses are doing the opposite, deploying it to extend what their workers can do and keep their teams intact

slides.headline: WHAT THIS MEANS FOR YOUR BUSINESS
slides.body: If you run a small business, AI is not a layoff tool — it's a force multiplier. One person doing the work of three isn't a cost cut, it's a competitive edge.
